Stage.LogText: {=sp_dg_s0_log}Having proven your loyalty to {Dost_Name} by executing the traitor, you now serve as an operative of the Scavenger Pigeons. Carry on with your affairs across the realm; time must pass until the 7th day of the season, when a pigeon courier will deliver your first sealed orders.

{=sp_dg_s1_log}First Assignment, The Vault of Whispers: On the 7th day of the season, a grey pigeon delivered {Dost_Name}'s encrypted crest. Ride to {OperatifSehir_Link} and meet cipher artisan {Operatif_Link} to recover stolen foreign garrison supply ledgers.

{=sp_dg_s2_wait_log}The decoded garrison ledgers from the Vault of Whispers have been sent to {Dost_Name}'s archive. Tend to your own affairs and wait for time to pass; the next pigeon dispatch will arrive on the 7th day of the next season.

{=sp_dg_s2_log}Second Assignment, The Blood-Sealed Cylinder: A new 7th-day dispatch from {Dost_Name} directs you to {KuryeSehir_Link}. Deliver an urgent, crimson wax-sealed cylinder to merchant broker {Kurye_Link} without breaking the seal.

{=sp_dg_s3_wait_log}The blood-sealed cylinder is now in the guild broker's vault. Continue your travels across the realm and let time pass until the 7th day of the next season, when {Dost_Name} will summon your blade for a frontier purge.

{=sp_dg_s3_log}Third Assignment, Frontier Purge: On the 7th day, {Dost_Name} sent word that renegades are threatening Pigeon supply routes near the frontier. Ride to {SinirKoyu_Link}, track down {SinirFirarileri_Link} patrolling around the village, and wipe them out.

{=sp_dg_s4_wait_log}The frontier roads are silent once more, yet the deserters' dying curses linger in your memory. Let time pass until the 7th day of the next season, when the deepest dispatch of the Scavenger Pigeons will find you.

{=sp_dg_s4_log}Fourth Assignment, The Shadow Decree: On the 7th day, an unmarked black pigeon arrived bearing the secret seal of the Deep Wing. Ride to {DerinKanatSehir_Link} and meet council envoy {DerinKanatUlagi_Link}. An unprecedented assassination decree has been issued: the target is none other than {Dost_Name}!

{=sp_dg_s_korsadakat_log}You refused to entertain the words of a traitor and struck down {DerinKanatUlagi_Link} where he stood. You reported the coup attempt to {Dost_Link}. Overwhelmed by your unyielding loyalty, {Dost_Name} rewarded you with 50,000 denars and named you his champion. But before the dust could settle, word arrived that another artisan, {YeniHainZanaatkar_Link}, has betrayed the circle and stolen master ciphers. The hunt begins anew!

{=sp_dg_s_golgerotasi_log}You held your blade and listened to {DerinKanatUlagi_Link}. The documents he provided tore the veil from your eyes: {Dost_Link} has orchestrated every crisis, every grain blockade, and every border raid to line his own pockets. The courier handed you the Raven Bone Cipher and directed you to the hidden sanctuary of the Shadow Roost. Yet {Dost_Name} already senses your defiance...
{=sp_dg_fail_s3_log}The Border Deserters overwhelmed your company near the frontier village. Supply routes fell into chaos, and your failure severely damaged your standing with {Dost_Name}.

Action.Title: {=sp_dg_inq_defeat_title}Defeat on the Frontier
Action.Text: {=sp_dg_fail_s3_log}The Border Deserters overwhelmed your company near the frontier village. Supply routes fell into chaos, and your failure severely damaged your standing with {Dost_Name}.

DialogNode.Text: {=sp_dg_dlg_s1_entry}I carry {Dost_Name}'s encrypted mark. What intelligence waits in the Vault of Whispers?

{=sp_dg_dlg_s1_a1}Lower your voice, operative. Foreign envoys have been bribing frontier quartermasters to leak garrison grain inventories and patrol shift rosters. Two of our night runners bled to death in the cellars last night snatching this codebook back before it crossed the border.
{=sp_dg_dlg_s1_p1_inq}Why would foreign spies pay in blood for grain manifests at backwater frontier keeps instead of army battle plans?
{=sp_dg_dlg_s1_p1_skep}{Dost_Name} sent me into the dark without telling me who died for these pages. Why keep this off royal ledgers?
{=sp_dg_dlg_s1_p1_prag}Spare me the cellar ghost stories. Tell me what these decoded plates unlock and let me ride.
{=sp_dg_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.

{=sp_dg_dlg_s1_a2}Armies march on granaries, not speeches! Knowing which castle runs short tells an enemy where to raid, and tells {Dost_Name} which panicked border lord will pay double for Pigeon escorts and mercenaries. Look closely at these cipher plates: the handwriting of three high lords sits beside foreign wax.
{=sp_dg_dlg_s1_p2_ask}Wait. Are you saying {Dost_Name} sells warnings to panicked lords instead of handing traitors straight to the crown?
{=sp_dg_dlg_s1_p2_loyal}High politics requires dirty hands. Those nobles would tear the kingdom apart if left unchecked.
{=sp_dg_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.

{=sp_dg_dlg_s1_a3}Careful how loudly you ask that question in these alleys, operative. The craftsman before you asked too many questions, and you remember how his story ended. Take these decoded ledgers; our runners will relay them to {Dost_Name}. Be ready when the next 7th day arrives.
{=sp_dg_dlg_s1_p3_acc}The ciphers are secured. Tell {Dost_Name} his operative awaits the next 7th-day dispatch.
{=sp_dg_dlg_s1_p3_prag}I do not ask questions I am not paid to ask. Forward the archive and burn the scraps.
{=sp_dg_dlg_s2_entry}I bear an unbroken crimson cylinder dispatched by {Dost_Name}.

{=sp_dg_dlg_s2_a1}By the heavens, hide it under the wool bales! Do you know how many guild merchants vanished inside their own cellars after hesitating over {Dost_Name}'s crimson crest? If the town watch glimpses that pigeon wax on my counter, I am finished.
{=sp_dg_dlg_s2_p1_inq}Why are your hands shaking? I was told this cylinder only holds caravan toll exemptions across the border.
{=sp_dg_dlg_s2_p1_skep}Honest brokers do not sweat blood over salt tariffs. What is locked inside that iron tube?
{=sp_dg_dlg_s2_p1_prag}Check the seal, pay the Pigeons' tithe, and spare me your trembling.
{=sp_dg_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.

{=sp_dg_dlg_s2_a2}Tariff exemptions?! Inside this tube sit forged grain-blockade decrees and extortion writs against every merchant house that refused to fund {Dost_Name}'s shadow coffers! Three rival caravans along the pass were gutted by so-called deserters the same night their elders refused his demands.
{=sp_dg_dlg_s2_p2_ask}Garrison supply ciphers first, and now blockade writs alongside caravan burnings... Who actually pays those deserters?
{=sp_dg_dlg_s2_p2_loyal}Every guild feeds off chaos until someone strong holds the reins. {Dost_Name} keeps order in the dark.
{=sp_dg_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.

{=sp_dg_dlg_s2_a3}Tell yourself whatever helps you sleep when the screams start at the border, soldier. The wax seal is unbroken, and the forged manifests will be filed tonight. Leave my stall before the watchers notice us speaking.
{=sp_dg_dlg_s2_p3_acc}My courier duty is done. Keep the ledger quiet and prepare your tribute.
{=sp_dg_dlg_s2_p3_prag}The cylinder reached your hands intact. What {Dost_Name} does with those merchants is his affair.
{=sp_dg_dlg_raiders_intro}Halt! Did {Dost_Name} send another lapdog to silence us?! We were promised silver for raiding those caravans, not an ambush on our own patrol!
{=sp_dg_dlg_raiders_p1}Spit all the lies you want. Your raids along this border end in blood today! (Fight)
{=sp_dg_dlg_raiders_p2}No mercenaries buy their survival with rumors. Draw your steel! (Fight)
{=sp_dg_dlg_d_entry}A black raven brought me your summons. Who are you, and what is this urgent contract?

{=sp_dg_dlg_d_npc}You proved your discipline through every cipher, courier run, and frontier purge, {PlayerName}. But the time for blind errands has ended. The deep wing of the Scavenger Pigeons has chosen you for the supreme task: {Dost_Link} must be executed tonight.
{=sp_dg_dlg_p_angry}Why are you committing such treachery?! Don't you know what happened to the last person who gave me this mission?! I hunted that artisan down and put him to the sword!
{=sp_dg_dlg_p_skep}Another assassination order against {Dost_Name}? Is this another twisted loyalty test orchestrated by the Pigeons, or have you all lost your minds?
{=sp_dg_dlg_p_prag}{Dost_Name} rewarded me with gold and honor, while you whisper treason in dark corners. Give me one reason not to take your head right now.
{=sp_dg_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.

{=sp_dg_dlg_d_reply}We are desperately trying to rid the realm of the true traitor to the motherland! {Dost_Name} is the real puppeteer of fabricated wars. The artisan you killed saw the darkness coming and tried to warn you! Every sealed dispatch you carried since his death didn't protect peace; they stoked border raids and grain panics for his personal profit!

{=sp_dg_dlg_p2_doubt}I broke foreign ciphers at the Vault of Whispers, delivered his crimson cylinder, and slaughtered the border deserters who cursed his name! Are you saying all of it was his puppet show?!
{=sp_dg_dlg_p2_accuse}And who gave your shadowy faction the right to pass judgment? Are you just another ambitious butcher seeking {Dost_Name}'s seat?
{=sp_dg_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.

{=sp_dg_dlg_d_facts}Yes, a puppet show of blood! The garrison ciphers you lifted handed him leverage over anxious frontier lords, and that crimson cylinder triggered a cruel grain blockade that starved loyalist houses! And those deserters you cut down at the border were mercenaries {Dost_Name} himself hired and silenced before they could talk! We are the Shadow Council who refuse to let the Motherland burn for one man's greed.
{=sp_dg_dlg_p3_proof}Show me your proof. If {Dost_Name} is the monster you claim, prove it before my blade draws your blood.
{=sp_dg_dlg_p3_defend}Words are cheap, and traitors always cloak themselves in righteousness. Why should I believe you over {Dost_Name}?
{=sp_dg_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.

{=sp_dg_dlg_d_plea}Listen to me; do not kill me right now, and let me prove to you that you are mistaken. If you are not convinced, my neck is forfeit to your blade! Here is the Raven Bone Cipher bearing the seal of the Shadow Council. Read the orders {Dost_Name} signed in secret, then make your choice!
{=sp_dg_dlg_ch_kill}I swore an oath to {Dost_Name} and the Motherland. No traitor's silver tongue will sway me! Die! (Execute the Courier & Stand with {Dost_Name})

{=sp_dg_dlg_ch_listen}If what you say about {Dost_Name}'s false wars is true, the realm has bled for a lie. Put away your fear; show me the proof of the Shadow Council. (Spare & Listen to the Courier)
